dedupe_keys.name: contributions du projet participatif inventons la route de demain

description: Contributions du projet participatif - Inventons la route de demain is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Ensemble des contributions recueillies au cours de la consultation « Inventons la route de demain », organisée par le Département de Loire Atlantique, entre le 11 juin et le 12 juillet 2018 en vue d’alimenter sa politique mobilités. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Citoyenneté / Institution. Its keywords are mobilité, participation citoyenne, route, partage, sécurité, environnement. The portal shows 365 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-04-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
